title: Conducting Wound, Ostomy, and Continence (WOC) Nurse Telephone Follow-up for Post-discharge Ostomy Patients to Reduce Hospital Readmission
official: Conducting Wound, Ostomy, and Continence (WOC) Nurse Telephone Follow-up for Post-discharge Ostomy Patients to Reduce Hospital Readmission
summary: The purpose of this research is to assess the impact of a telephone follow-up visit on rehospitalizations after ostomy surgery.

interventions.name: Wound, Ostomy, and Continence (WOC) Nurse Telephone Follow-up

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All adult patients with new ostomy
* Able to consent to participate in the study
* English speaking
* Patients who are willing to participate

Exclusion Criteria:

• ostomy revision surgery
